settings._title: FAQ – How much does a website cost?

settings.editor: Most business websites fall between a small starter site and a larger custom build. After a short call we send a fixed quote with no hidden costs.

settings._title: FAQ – Which platform do you use?

settings.editor: We mainly build on WordPress with Elementor, so you can easily edit content yourself. For online stores we use WooCommerce.

settings._title: FAQ – Will my website be mobile-frie

settings.editor: Yes. Every website is responsive, speed-optimised and includes on-page SEO basics like titles, meta descriptions, headings and schema.

settings._title: FAQ – Do you offer maintenance after

settings.editor: Yes – every site includes 30 days of free support, and optional monthly care plans cover updates, backups and security.
